items.title: JNJ Stock Edges Up After-Hours On Apollo’s $20B Orthopedics Talks
items.summary: People familiar with the discussions told Bloomberg that Apollo is working toward a valuation of close to $20 billion for the unit, known as DePuy Synthes.

items.title: Apollo Global Is Said in Talks to Acquire J&J’s Orthopedics Unit
items.summary: Alternative asset manager Apollo Global Management Inc. is in discussions to acquire the Johnson & Johnson orthopedics unit that the conglomerate has been looking to separate, according to people familiar with the matter.

items.title: Private Equity Wants Your Broken Garage Door. Why KKR Thinks They Are Worth $2 Billion
items.summary: KKR manages nearly $800 billion in assets, yet its next big bet is a Phoenix company that fixes broken garage doors. The logic behind a $2 billion valuation reveals something unsettling about where private equity is hunting for returns.
